job.job_description:
Role: Spatial AI Engineer
Job Type: Full Time
Job Location: Noida (Onsite)
About the role:
A Spatial AI Engineer develops intelligent solutions that analyze and interpret location-based data. By combining AI with GIS, maps, satellite imagery, and spatial datasets, they help organizations make smarter decisions related to geography, infrastructure, retail expansion, logistics, and urban planning.
Requirements:
Education Qualification
Full-time Engineering degree in Data Science/ AI&ML/ Computational Mathematics/ Statistics or related field.
Added Advantage:
Relevant certifications or notable achievements in geography, GIS, urban planning, sustainability, environmental studies, spatial research, or interdisciplinary programs.
Required Skills
Experience in GIS, geospatial analytics, or Spatial AI.
Experience with mapping platforms, geospatial databases, and GIS tools.
Knowledge of AI, Machine Learning, and spatial data analysis.
Proficiency in Python and geospatial processing frameworks.
Strong analytical and visualization skills.
Responsibilities:
Develop AI solutions using geospatial and location-based data.
Build models utilizing maps, GIS systems, satellite imagery, and spatial datasets.
Create location intelligence dashboards and analytical tools.
Integrate AI and machine learning models with geospatial data sources.
Optimize geospatial processing and analytics workflows.
Support development of spatial decision-support applications.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
